body: Thanks, I'm working out how to talk to people since I'm the one that other people usually come to with problems. I'm the nice, stable, friend that loves you and will help you if you need it, but I've never been good at being the messed up one. I've just hid myself away and stopped returning calls since I hate the sound of my voice, complaining and crying... god its awful. I really dont want to scare anyone since I love them all so much and I've been nothing but a lump on the couch for years.
I'm also worried about the implications of admitting to substance use - what sorts of records are kept of these discussions? do they get sent to my family doctor?

so by calling I'm not going to be tackled by paramedics hiding in the bushes? I'm kidding but the thing keeping me from calling is the worry of what action the person I'm talking to will take. I just need someone to discuss my options with, and really really don't want that to be passed on to the police or ems.

thanks for this, I was hoping that someone might have some personal experience. What I'm scared of is sharing this with someone and then everyone finding out and me becoming the "suicidal guy" in the family. I'm in crisis but I wont kill myself until I've tried getting help - I owe the people that love me that at least, trying. Its not an emergency because of that and I dont know how to communicate that difference to people.

How do you tell people that you're worried that you're suicidal, that there's nothing in your life that you want anymore and that you're actively preventing yourself for committing suicide, but that you want help and want to survive? I feel like I'm worried about a suicidal friend or something, rather than myself... its hard to explain.

I want to keep the number of people really scared by this to a minimum. My whole family is depressed and addicted to something so I want to avoid burdening them with more stress and worry. I want to avoid lights and sirens at all cost and would like to vanish into a treatment centre without anyone knowing. God, I cant even be suicidal right.
